StringProperty.Name: CompilerExecutable
StringProperty.Description: Path to the Thava compiler executable (thavac.exe). Leave as default to use THAVA_SDK_DIR or system PATH.

EnumProperty.Name: EntryPointRole
EnumProperty.Description: Controls whether this .thv file is compiled as a standalone entry point or skipped because it is included via @attach in another file.

EnumValue.Name: Auto
EnumValue.Description: Automatically skip standalone compilation if another .thv file in the project includes this file via @attach.

EnumValue.Name: EntryPoint
EnumValue.Description: Always compile this file into the project target output.

EnumValue.Name: Module
EnumValue.Description: Treat this file as an @attach module and do not compile it standalone.

EnumProperty.Name: BackendMode
EnumProperty.Description: Select the code generation backend for the Thava compiler.

EnumValue.Name: Native
EnumValue.Description: Zero-dependency direct native machine code generation for host architecture.

EnumValue.Name: CppTranspiler
EnumValue.Description: Transpile to optimized C++17 and compile using the detected host C++ compiler.

EnumValue.Name: WinArm64
EnumValue.Description: Emit native Windows ARM64 PE32+ (0xAA64) executable directly.

EnumValue.Name: LinuxElf64
EnumValue.Description: Emit standalone Linux x86-64 ELF64 binary directly.

EnumValue.Name: LinuxArm64
EnumValue.Description: Emit standalone Linux AArch64 (ARM64) ELF64 binary directly.

EnumProperty.Name: OutputBuildType
EnumProperty.Description: Build as a standalone executable (.exe) or a Thava Dynamic Library (.thdl).

EnumValue.Name: DynamicLibrary
EnumValue.Description: Build a dynamic library with embedded symbol metadata.

StringProperty.Name: OutputFile
StringProperty.Description: The output file path (-o) produced by the Thava compiler.

EnumProperty.Name: OptimizationLevel
EnumProperty.Description: Select the AST and machine code optimization level (-O0 to -O3).

EnumValue.Name: O0
EnumValue.Description: No optimizations. Fastest compilation for debugging.

EnumValue.Name: O1
EnumValue.Description: Compile-time constant folding and algebraic simplifications.

EnumValue.Name: O2
EnumValue.Description: Expand inline functions and prune unreachable branches.

EnumValue.Name: O3
EnumValue.Description: Full AST optimization, memory-direct arithmetic, and register scheduling.

EnumProperty.Name: HostCppCompiler
EnumProperty.Description: Specify the host C++ compiler when using C++17 Transpiler mode or C attachments.

EnumValue.Name: Auto
EnumValue.Description: Automatically probe g++, clang++, c++, or MSVC cl.exe.

StringProperty.Name: AdditionalOptions
StringProperty.Description: Additional command-line flags passed directly to thavac.exe.
